## Highlights

- **Dynamic H.264 level selection:** Automatically selects the appropriate H.264 level based on resolution and frame rate, with support up to Level 6.2 and an optional manual override in Video Settings.
- **More flexible configuration summaries:** Added controls to choose where configuration summaries appear in the Hosts and Apps sections.
- **Improved streaming reliability:** Refined subsystem timeouts and error reporting to provide more contextual information when operations fail.
- **Improved Smart Hub quick-start:** Reworked the quick-start flow to use the shared streaming transition interface and correctly restore previously saved streaming settings.
- **Refined interface and streaming defaults:** Improved the main interface background and enabled Video frame pacing and Host address field mode by default.
- **Improved H.264 compatibility:** Fixed H.264 MIME profile-level-id generation.
- **Fixed host-initiated stream disconnections:** Updated Moonlight Common C to handle host-initiated stream disconnections gracefully.
